---
title: "Seattle Temperatures"
subtitle: "Historical monthly temperatures in Seattle, WA."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [Seattle
Temperatures](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/seattle-temp.html) from
the mosaic/vgplot example gallery. The gray range shows the minimum and
maximum recorded temperatures; the blue range shows the average lows and
highs.

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "Seattle Temperatures",
    description = paste(
      "Historical monthly temperatures in Seattle, WA. The gray range shows the minimum",
      "and maximum recorded temperatures. The blue range shows the average lows and highs."
    )
  ) |>
  vg_data(name = "weather", file = vg_data_url("seattle-weather.parquet")) |>
  vg_mark_area_y(
    data_from = "weather",
    x = ~ vg_date_month(date),
    y1 = ~ vg_max(temp_max),
    y2 = ~ vg_min(temp_min),
    fill = "#ccc",
    fill_opacity = 0.25,
    curve = "monotone-x"
  ) |>
  vg_mark_area_y(
    data_from = "weather",
    x = ~ vg_date_month(date),
    y1 = ~ vg_avg(temp_max),
    y2 = ~ vg_avg(temp_min),
    fill = "steelblue",
    fill_opacity = 0.75,
    curve = "monotone-x"
  ) |>
  vg_mark_rule_y(
    data_from = c(15),
    stroke_opacity = 0.5,
    stroke_dasharray = "5 5"
  ) |>
  vg_guide_x(tick_format = "%b") |>
  vg_guide_y(label = "Temperature Range (°C)") |>
  vg_plot(width = 680, height = 300)

vg_render(spec)
```

<details>
<summary>Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec</summary>

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/seattle-temp.html) exactly,
aside from `data.weather.file` (`vg_data_url()` vs. a relative path) and
object key order.
</details>
